coastal_zone: Karnataka Coast and adjoining Southeast Arabian Sea
warning_text: Squally weather with wind speed reaching 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail along and off Karnataka coast. Fishermen are advised NOT to venture into sea during the period.
